title: The Jan Samarth Portal
description: Context: The Ministry of Finance marked the 4th anniversary of the Jan Samarth Portal, highlighting its role in digital financial inclusion. Launched In: The portal was officially launched on June 6, 2022, as a part of the government’s digital public infrastructure (DPI) drive for financial inclusion. Aim: The objective is to scale up the reach of government-sponsored subsidy schemes and streamline the credit delivery process. By removing procedural delays and middlemen, it aims to deliver accessible, transparent, and timely institutional loans to small business owners, farmers, startup founders, and rural self-help groups.
